map.住宅单向板（长边/短边≥2）：取短跨弯矩配底筋，长跨配分布筋。: Residential one-way slabs (long side / short side ≥ 2): provide bottom steel for the short-span moment and distribution steel for the long span.
map.连续板按塑性/弹性系数：中间支座负弯矩大于跨中，需分离式或弯起配筋。: Continuous slabs use plastic or elastic coefficients: the negative moment at an interior support exceeds the mid-span value, so use split or bent-up reinforcement.
map.最小配筋率与裂缝：薄板需满足 ρmin 并控制间距防裂。: Minimum reinforcement ratio and cracking: thin slabs must satisfy ρmin and limit the bar spacing to control cracking.
map.3m 单向板跨中配筋: Mid-span reinforcement of a 3 m one-way slab
map.板厚 h=100、h0=80、q=8kN/m²、L=3m：M=ql²/8=8×9: With h = 100, h0 = 80, q = 8 kN/m² and L = 3 m: M = ql²/8 = 8 × 9/8 = 9 kN·m/m. For C25 with HRB400, αs = M/(α₁fc b h0²) ≈ 0.043, ξ ≈ 0.044 and As = ξ·b·h0·α₁·fc/fy ≈ 0.044 × 1000 × 80 × 11.9/360 ≈ 117 mm²/m, so adopt Φ8@200 (251).
map.单向板和双向板怎么分？: How do you tell a one-way slab from a two-way slab?
map.长短边比≥2 按单向板（短跨受力），<2 按双向板（两向受力）；误判会改变配筋方: A long-to-short side ratio ≥ 2 makes it a one-way slab (short span carries the load); below 2 it is two-way (both directions act). Misjudging it changes the reinforcement direction and leaves the member under-reinforced.
map.最小配筋率多少？: What is the minimum reinforcement ratio?
map.连续板为何支座负筋多？: Why is there more negative steel at the supports of a continuous slab?
map.连续板支座负弯矩常大于跨中正弯矩，负筋（上层）承担支座拉力，分离式配筋需在支座上: The support negative moment of a continuous slab is often larger than the mid-span positive moment, and the negative steel (top layer) carries the support tension. Split reinforcement therefore needs top bars at the supports and bottom bars at mid-span.
map.a_s 受拉钢筋合力点至板底距离 (mm): a_s — distance from the slab soffit to the centroid of tension steel (mm)
map.a_s 为受拉钢筋合力点至板底距离（h₀ = h − a_s），不是保护层厚度: a_s is the distance from the slab soffit to the centroid of the tension steel (h₀ = h − a_s), not the cover thickness c. A single-row slab usually takes about 20 mm; c is counted separately.
map.受弯板 ρmin = max(0.20%, 45f_t/f_y)，C25/C30: For flexural slabs, ρmin = max(0.20%, 45f_t/f_y); with C25/C30 concrete and HRB400 steel the 0.20% floor governs (GB 50010-2010 Table 8.5.1). Provide construction bars of about Φ8@200 per meter to control shrinkage and temperature cracking.
